Title: Public preview: Monitor Spring Boot apps in Azure Spring Cloud with AppDynamics

Body.Content:
Spring Boot applications running in the cloud need to be instrumented for application performance monitoring (APM). Azure Spring Cloud provides a fully managed platform for running your Spring Boot apps, and now you can keep using familiar APM solutions like AppDynamics to ensure continuity. AppDynamics provides end-to-end monitoring, automatically discovering and mapping all applications, microservices, infrastructure, and dependencies in dynamic hybrid, multicloud environments.

Learn more.
